A [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] '''member''' of the [[Ryn Network]] aided [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Tahiri Veila]], and several of their friends on [[Galantos]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. He later reported to [[Droma]], the leader of the network, giving positive feedback about Veila.
